title: Staff Android Engineer
content: <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2><p>Northwind Labs builds tooling used by small businesses to manage payments and payroll. The mobile group owns the customer-facing apps.</p><h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2><ul><li>Own the architecture of our Android application, from modularization to offline sync</li><li>Ship features in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, coroutines and Flow</li><li>Partner with backend and iOS leads on shared API and release strategy</li><li>Mentor engineers through design reviews and pairing</li></ul><h2><strong>What we look for</strong></h2><ul><li>6+ years of Android development, including large production apps</li><li>Experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines</li><li>Kotlin Multiplatform experience is a plus</li></ul><p>This role is open to remote candidates within the United States.</p>
